text: dsh-file-upload-local 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话文件上传插件，在输入框加入回形针按钮和全屏拖放入口，将文件按会话保存到工作区。发送消息时，附件路径会随文本一并提交；agent 可用 read_document 分页读取文本文件，也可将图片 OCR 成文字。上传界面显示附件缩略图或文件类型，并支持移除附件。适合需要在 DSH 对话中提供本地文档、截图或照片的用户。图片识别由 tesseract.js 处理，首次使用需要下载 OCR 语言包。

dsh-file-upload-local adds paperclip and drag-and-drop uploads to DSH web chats, storing files by session. The agent can page through text or OCR images with read_document. Previews and removal controls appear in the composer. First-use OCR downloads the tesseract.js language pack.
想把本地文件直接作为附件发到 DSH 对话里。
有没有办法把截图拖进会话，再让模型读出图片里的文字？
I want the agent to read a long text file I attached, a few lines at a time.
dsh-file-upload-local 的功能「会话附件上传」：可从输入框按钮选择多个文件，也可拖放到网页任意位置；界面展示附件并允许移除，发送时将文件路径附加到消息。
dsh-file-upload-local 的功能「分页阅读与图片 OCR」：agent 调用 read_document 并传入文件路径、起始行和页长，可获取带行号的文本页；图片则识别为文字返回。
dsh-file-upload-local 使用前须知：首次进行图片 OCR 时，tesseract.js 会下载 chi_sim+eng 语言包，因此需要可用网络或预先准备缓存。

dsh-file-upload-local README · dsh-file-upload-local：A local file-upload plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Upload files straight into the conversation via a paperclip button or drag-and-drop; files are stored per-session under `.dsh-uploads/<sessionId>/` inside the session workspace, and the agent reads them with the `read_document` tool.

[中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-file-upload-local README · Features：- **Upload surface**: a paperclip button in the composer's left slot, plus a full-viewport drag-and-drop overlay.
- **Attachment rail**: uploaded images render 64px thumbnails (click to open), other files render type glyphs with names; each tile has a hover remove button. References are appended invisibly to the sent text on Enter or the send button.
- **`read_document` tool**: pages through text files with line numbers (`offset`/`limit`), and OCRs images with tesseract.js (`chi_sim+eng`) so a text-only model can still read screenshots and photos.
- **Per-session isolation**: files land in `.dsh-uploads/<sessionId>/` under the session workspace; TTL sweep keeps it from growing unbounded.

dsh-file-upload-local README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-upload-local

dsh-file-upload-local README · Use：1. Click the paperclip button, or drag files anywhere onto the window.
2. Files appear as thumbnails above the composer; remove any with its ✕ button.
3. Send the message — the agent reads uploaded files with `read_document <path>` (text pages, image OCR).

dsh-file-upload-local README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: dsh-file-upload-local
  config:
    uploadMaxBytes: 26214400   # single upload body cap
    uploadTtlMs: 604800000     # 7 days

dsh-file-upload-local README · Notes：- The OCR language pack (`chi_sim+eng`) is downloaded by tesseract.js on first use; keep network access or pre-seed the cache.
- Images travel through the OCR path (`read_document`), so a text-only model works out of the box. If the active model supports image input, you can still use the official `read_image` tool directly.
